method: Vmon=Vthreshold*(1+Rtop/Rbottom)+Isense*Rtop. Cartesian corners: threshold +/-1%, Isense conservatively +/-100nA, resistance initial tolerance plus independent TCR*deltaT. No assumed matched tracking. SENSE leakage table applies with VDD>=1.5V; does not bound unpowered SENSE backfeed.

bleeder_comparison.assumptions: Target3.47V; precision divider initial0.1% plus25ppm/K over100K; bleeder1% plus manufacturer100ppm/K over100K. Cout upper-screen12.397uF=9.8uF*1.1*1.15. Exact Yageo generated specs confirm100ppm/K for10k and100k variants.
bleeder_comparison.interpretation: 10k reduces passive dwell and sense-only parasitic rail voltage by approximately one order of magnitude. Sense-only bound assumes no external injection except169k target divider and a hypothetical ideal forward short fromSENSE toUSB_IF. It does not bound data-pin injection, active discharge behavior, startup, regulator residual output or other leakage. Switch Ioff atVCC=0 cannot be applied to nonzero rail. No complete isolation guarantee.
